title: Lazy Initialization Pattern
overview: Defer the creation of an object until it is first needed, saving resources when the object may never be used.
useCases: Expensive parts of a class may never actually be used
You want to improve startup time by deferring heavy work until it is first needed
Creating all possible instances upfront would waste memory or I/O (e.g. loading config files, database connections)
exampleUses: A spell-checker that only loads its dictionary into memory when the user first invokes spell-check
A report module that connects to an analytics database only when a report is actually requested
An image editor that decodes high-resolution thumbnails only when the user scrolls to that part of the gallery
